sheets.prompt: Character model sheet for 3D modelling and rigging, two full-body views side by side on a plain light cream background: on the left the front view, on the right the back view, both the same size and standing on the same level line. Even flat lighting, no cast shadows, no ground shadow, orthographic view with no perspective, the whole body in frame with a margin all round, clean fine ink contours and flat colours as in the reference.
